name: Zoho Analytics
description: Zoho Analytics is a business-intelligence and analytics platform for combining data, building reports and dashboards, and sharing governed insights. Teams use it to organize reporting workspaces, model data, visualize performance, and collaborate around analysis.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Zoho Analytics account through Relay-owned multi-data-center OAuth, then let selected agents list bounded workspace and view identity metadata. Rows, columns, descriptions, creator identities, users, exports, embeds, writes, pagination, and raw APIs are outside V1.

capabilities.label: Read Analytics workspace metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded workspace and view identity metadata without rows, columns, creator identities, exports, embeds, writes, or raw responses.

approvalRequired.label: List Analytics workspaces
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five owned and shared workspace summaries from the bounded metadata endpoint.

approvalRequired.label: List workspace views
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five view identity summaries for one exact numeric organization and workspace.

blocked.label: Access rows or columns
blocked.description: Table rows, columns, formulas, charts, dashboards, reports, and underlying business data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access descriptions or identities
blocked.description: Descriptions, creator identities, user lists, collaboration details, and permission inventories are outside V1.

blocked.label: Modify or export Zoho Analytics
blocked.description: Writes, imports, administration, exports, embeds, arbitrary endpoints, automatic pagination, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded metadata reads require approval; business data, identities, exports, embeds, and mutations remain outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact user, regional origin, scope, bounds, audits, and privacy exclusions remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts two typed metadata wrappers and attaches the encrypted token only to the exact regional Accounts and Analytics API origins.
Railway mounts two typed metadata wrappers and attaches the encrypted token only to the exact regional Accounts and Analytics API origins.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's multi-data-center Zoho server application, exact callback, shared client credentials, Railway staging configuration, and representative Zoho Analytics consent are not configured in this code-only worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console task, create or extend Relay's Zoho server application, enable Multi-DC with shared credentials for the eight documented Analytics data centers, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/zoho-analytics/callback, request only AaaServer.profile.Read and ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read, configure ZOHO_ANALYTICS_CLIENT_ID and ZOHO_ANALYTICS_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway staging, then validate regional consent, exact-user binding, both bounded wrappers, refresh, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Zoho documents OAuth 2.0 access and refresh tokens, Zoho-oauthtoken authorization, and module-specific Analytics scopes.
Zoho documents the Analytics V2 request conventions, regional Analytics API and Accounts origins, organization header, configuration parameter, and JSON response envelope.
Zoho documents GET /restapi/v2/workspaces under ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read and the owned/shared workspace identifiers, names, organization IDs, and metadata that Relay strictly projects.
Zoho documents the workspace Views metadata route, required organization header, bounded start and result configuration, and view identifiers, names, and types.
Zoho documents Multi-DC server clients, regional callback and token exchange, shared credentials, api_domain verification, and regional Accounts authorities.
